strategic_architecture: Solo-commander Izzet (U/R) spellslinger storm/combo archetype, distinct from the creature-centric or toolbox archetypes above. Vivi grows with every noncreature spell cast and converts its power into mana; typical game plan chains cheap noncreature spells into card draw (Curiosity-effects on Vivi) toward Underworld Breach/Brain Freeze mill loops or direct combo kills, protected by a dense free-counterspell suite. Sources: Draftsim 'Vivi Ornitier Commander Deck Guide', Cards Realm 'cEDH Deck Tech: Vivi Ornitier'.
